d: Long, flowing honey-blonde hair with straight bangs and two sweeping side locks frames a youthful, adolescent face with golden-yellow, narrow eyes. The slender build is dressed in a dark navy sailor-style uniform consisting of a long-sleeved top with a white collar and necktie, paired with a matching pleated mini-skirt and dark navy stockings. This outfit is complemented by brown shoes and large, grey metallic naval rigging featuring multiple gun barrels and armored plates attached to the sides and lower leg.
